abstract: A human nongestational choriocarcinoma cell line of ovarian origin (IMa) was established in vitro. This cell line had been subcultured serially more than 22 times over 18 months. Small polygonal cells with a prominent nucleus were dominant and a sparsity of cytoplasmic organelles was an ultrastructural characteristic of the IMa cells. The production and secretion of human chorionic gonadotropin and its subunits were identified by radioimmunoassay. The IMa cells were transplantable in the hamster cheek pouch and the histological diagnosis was choriocarcinoma. A newly established ovarian choriocarcinoma cell line can be considered useful for clarifying the biological differences between nongestational and gestational choriocarcinoma cells.
abstract_ja: 非妊娠性の卵巣由来ヒト絨毛癌細胞株(IMa)をin vitroで樹立した。この細胞株は18か月間に22回以上継代培養された。小型で多角形の細胞で核が目立つものが優勢であり、細胞質小器官に乏しいことがIMa細胞の超微細構造的特徴であった。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンおよびそのサブユニットの産生と分泌を放射免疫測定法で確認した。IMa細胞はハムスター頬嚢に移植可能であり、組織学的診断は絨毛癌であった。新たに樹立された卵巣絨毛癌細胞株は、非妊娠性絨毛癌と妊娠性絨毛癌の細胞の生物学的差異を明らかにするうえで有用と考えられる。
